comparison.objective: Candidate mounts rigid rack hardware; record sifts soil into a tub while retaining pebbles.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires rigid-part alignment, latching, extension, and fastening; record requires bimanual lifting and shaking of a loaded sieve with granular-material containment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks mechanical engagement and screws; record checks soil mass through the mesh, pebble retention, no material over the rim, and final sieve support.
comparison.reason: Rigid structural assembly and granular separation exercise different physics and manipulation skills. Candidate lacks quantitative spill-independent force and overload limits, but there is no plausible duplicate.
